upstream.target: x86_64 Linux LP64 static library, cmake -DZLIB_COMPAT=ON -DWITH_OPTIM=OFF -DWITH_CRC32_CHORBA=OFF -DWITH_RUNTIME_CPU_DETECTION=OFF

summary.en: The version, error-string, CRC-32, adler32_combine and compressBound functions of zlib-ng (develop branch, with fifteen patches) are proved safe, and most of them functionally correct; adler32 and adler32_z, streaming deflate, inflate, one-shot and gz* safety are not done.
summary.zh: zlib-ng（develop 分支，含十五个补丁）的版本、错误字符串、CRC-32、adler32_combine 与 compressBound 函数已证明安全，其中多数已证明功能正确；adler32 与 adler32_z、流式 deflate、inflate、单次调用与 gz* 系列的安全性尚未完成。
